errors.evidence: The chart clearly shows six categories (дизел, бензин, електрически, хибридни, plug-n хибрид, други), not five.
The description completely omits the 'дизел' (diesel) category, which accounts for 12.70% of the total and is represented by the light blue slice.
The chart contains two different blue slices (light blue for 'дизел' and dark blue for 'plug-n хибрид'), but the description just says 'в синьо' (in blue) without specifying which one.

errors.text_span: Визуално секторите са подредени по низходящ ред на големина, започвайки от бензиновите автомобили и завършвайки с „други“.
errors.evidence: The slices are not arranged in descending order of size. For example, clockwise from the top, the values are 12.70%, 34.40%, 14.40%, 29.50%, 6.10%, 2.90%, which is not a sorted sequence.
